bio.text: Joanne Kuniansky is the Socialist Workers Party candidate for U.S. Senate in New Jersey.
Kuniansky, 73, was born in New Jersey, attended high school in Atlanta, and lives in West New York, New Jersey.
WHYY reports that she joined the Socialist Workers Party in 1977 and has worked as a refinery operator, meat packer, machine operator and deli worker, and has been a union activist.
